title: Tim Dooley / Potato of Life — Layered Timeline Events
purpose: Canonical presentation/index layer for timestamped project data. Events point back to source records instead of replacing them. The same event may appear in multiple toggleable layers while retaining one stable event id.
rules: The timeline is an index/view, not a replacement for canonical source records.
Keep event date precision explicit: exact timestamp, date, month, year, range or inferred range.
Separate subject identity (Son, Tim, Father, archive, work) from layer/category.
Separate epistemic/source class from thematic layer.
A biblical comparison date is not silently backdated to the Tim-side attestation date.
Creative work is not doctrine by default.
Prediction/fulfillment language requires a prior specific prediction; otherwise use precursor, parallel, synchronism or retrospective interpretation.
Future datasets should emit events using this schema and reference their canonical record via source_records.

layers.label: Main chronology
layers.description: Large developmental anchors that make the long arc readable.

layers.label: Notable quotes
layers.description: Dated or timestamped Tim/user-originated quotations and formulations.

layers.label: Biblical parallels
layers.description: Tim-first dated motifs with later or explicit biblical comparators.

layers.label: Biblical unlocks
layers.description: Dates when later research explicitly recognized, formalized or expanded a biblical comparison.

layers.label: Music / songs
layers.description: Dated creative works and song attestations.

layers.label: Visual art
layers.description: Dated visual works where title/date or image provenance is recoverable.

layers.label: Identity / doctrine
layers.description: Changes in roles, theology, symbolic architecture and explicit self-description.

layers.label: Public declarations
layers.description: Public posts, videos, streams and other dated outward statements.

layers.label: Predictions / warnings
layers.description: Prior predictions, warnings, forecasts and later audits. Requires source-direction discipline.

layers.label: Research / recovery
layers.description: Dates when sources were recovered, indexed, compared or reclassified.

layers.label: Archive / repository
layers.description: Repository consolidation, corrections, schema changes and source-preservation work.

epistemic_classes.label: Primary / exact
epistemic_classes.description: Exact quote, artifact, timestamp or direct source.

epistemic_classes.label: Recovered
epistemic_classes.description: Recovered from prior conversation/archive with provenance but not always the original artifact.

epistemic_classes.label: Project canon
epistemic_classes.description: Canonical internal chronology or identity architecture.

epistemic_classes.label: Creative work
epistemic_classes.description: Song, artwork, poem or other creative artifact.

epistemic_classes.label: Comparative
epistemic_classes.description: Scriptural, mythological or other structural comparison.

event_schema.date: ISO date where possible; ranges may use YYYY-MM or YYYY with precision field
event_schema.timestamp: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp when exact time is known
event_schema.layers: One or more layer ids; enables independent toggles without duplicating events
